shared_elements: fine incised or drawn linear patterning covering the surface
stylised head with prominent eyes seen frontally
an object held or carried in a raised position

justification: Both share only generic traits: an ochre-toned surface covered with fine incised or drawn linear motifs, a frontal staring face, and a held object raised in the upper part of the field. The biggest difference is medium and mode — A is a flat, weathered stone slab in shallow relief with stacked registers of animals, while B is a fully modelled, painted three-dimensional human figure in dramatic action against a blank interior wall.
